title: input timing (schema 1)
description: data/input/timing.json: every tick value of the input scheme: hold thresholds, the perfect-block windows, buffers and lockouts, the attack queue, the mode toggle, touch gestures, stick and trigger settings, and the hit-stop table (docs/controls/input-schema.md section 5; it carries over feel-schema.md's hit-stop, hold and stick values). Times are whole ticks at 60 per second unless a key says otherwise (px, dp, ki, fractions). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore; hitstopTicks takes underscore comment keys. An unfunded signature is refused at once, so there is no unfunded-expiry key (I2c). chordWindow, stateTicks and awayDead are required; dodge.lungeTicks and stick.fullAt are optional (code defaults 12 and 0.9) until Controls' data carries them. Cross-references (timing-order, timing-perfect, timing-hold, timing-hitstop-order, timing-hitstop-budget) are checked by tools/lib/xref-input.js.

chordWindow.description: Ticks within which the controls of a chord must all be down (I2c).

lungeTicks.description: The free lunge (today's dash) that goes with a dodge, in ticks (12 by default in code until the director moves the fighter itself).

style.description: How the mode control works by default: hold (momentary energy, the default) or toggle (the old latch, the accessibility setting).

aim.description: The stick as an aim (docs/controls/agency-input.md 1b, sim/input/aim.gd): the 8-sector snap and the latch of the launch direction. Optional: the code defaults are these values.

deadZone.description: The stick must pass this fraction of full deflection to aim (0.35; the move dead zone is 0.2).

latchTicks.description: The latest aim within this many ticks of the launch decision still counts (12).

snapMax.description: The director snaps to a target within this many 45-degree sectors (1).

dwellTicks.description: The zip's exit read: a stick direction counts as held if it was the sector for at least this many of the last exitWindow ticks (3).

exitWindow.description: The exit read looks back this many ticks (12; the sample ring holds 12).

nudgeStart.description: The brawl's nudge ramp (SimAim.nudge_ramp): a fresh push of the stick starts at this share of full (0.4).

nudgeTicks.description: ... and the nudge rises to full over this many ticks (12); letting go is instant.

stance.description: The stance buttons (docs/controls/lunge-control.md A2, sim/input/stance.gd, layout.gd). Optional: the code defaults are these values.

releaseGrace.description: A released stance button keeps the stance mask this many ticks, so a flutter of the finger does not flicker the stance (2). The mask only: the button's own fields end at once.

oneshotTicks.description: With one-shot arming on, a tap on a stance button arms the stance for the next blow, and it lapses unspent after this many ticks (90).

haptics.description: The pulses the host plays on a pad or a phone (docs/controls/haptics.md, sim/input/haptics.gd). Optional: the code defaults are these values. Never the only cue.

minGapMs.description: A second request for the same slot inside this many milliseconds is dropped (80).

padMinMs.description: The shortest pad pulse: a motor needs about 20 to 40 ms to spin up, so a shorter step is lengthened to this (20).

scaleMin.description: The factor a scale of 0 gives (a scale of 1 gives 1): motors are multiplied by it, a phone's pulse shortened by it (0.35).

padMinStrength.description: A motor is never scaled below this, since a pad does not feel less (0.15).

gripSteps.description: The clinch's grip steps: the grip over this is the clinch pulse's scale (5).

sharpBoost.description: A sharp surge adds this to the struggle push's scale (0.25).

launch_open.description: A launch has opened for the fighter who may launch (the lit B): a thump, then a ring 90 ms later (Audio's shape).

ms.description: The pulse's length, raised to padMinMs; 0 leaves the step out.

pad.description: A pad's steps: up to four, each played at its own time.

ms.description: The vibration's length, raised to handheldMinMs; 0 leaves the step out.

gapMs.description: The least time between two of this kind for one slot, so a pressed button or a steady beat never makes the pad buzz without a break (never under minGapMs).

form_prompt.description: His form is ready: two light taps, the second firmer.

switches.description: Parked behaviours (docs/controls/brake-and-grapple.md): each is off until its owner switches it on. Optional: absent is off.

airBrakeGuard.description: While the host says a Simple slot's fighter is sent, Guard held sets stanceMask bit 8, the air brake's (off).

grappleReads.description: SimPressRead.a_read drops the shove and the clinch-by-mash; the grapple's catch_read and brace_read replace them (off).

hapticLadder.description: The strike stick's charge ladder rumbles: one pulse as each rung is reached (docs/controls/rule-of-cool-pitches.md pitch 1; sim/input/haptics.gd ladder_1 to ladder_3). Needs rightStick. Off.

hapticIncoming.description: A rival's stick strike rumbles on the defender's pad as it starts: high for toward and up, low for away and down (pitch 3; incoming_high, incoming_low). Needs rightStick. Off.

hapticRefused.description: A stick press the director never started a strike for tells its pad: the stick_refused knocks, refuseTicks live ticks after the request or as soon as Encounter's stick_refused cue says so (the audit's gap 2). Needs rightStick. Off.

webRumble.description: On a web page the pad's rumble is asked of the browser directly (the pad's vibrationActuator, dual-rumble), because the Godot web runtime has no pad rumble of its own. Chromium browsers support it; Firefox and Safari do nothing. Render side only: never the sim. Off.

driverOnRb.description: With signatureRtOnly: RB + B is left as the B press for the Driver (data/director/interrupts.json blast.driver.enabled) instead of being sent as Y's blast. Set together with the Driver's switch. Off.

signatureRtOnly.description: The signature is RT + B only (docs/design/energy-overhaul.md E121): B with LB, RB or LT held is the heavy of that stance (B with RB is Y's blast until the Driver exists), so a guard or a dodge never fires a beam by accident. B alone stays the big blow. Off.

specialsOff.description: The power specials are off (docs/design/pad-first-press.md): with RT held, X, Y and A are the plain blows of their base buttons and the charge drops. Off.

beamAim.description: The beam's aim (docs/controls/beam-aim-feel.md; needs rightStick): the strike stick's aim trails the thumb by strike.aimTrail degrees, and the throw carries the aim the stick held at the rim instead of the zero of a stick that has sprung home. Off.

flickKept.description: Set together with the director's flickKeep (data/director/stick.json): the director holds a flick it cannot start yet, quietly, up to 90 ticks, so the hub waits strike.refuseTicksKept instead of strike.refuseTicks before it calls a stick request unanswered (docs/controls/flick-kept.md). Off: refuseTicks, as before.

chordPick.description: Two attack presses on one tick (B with X or Y, or Y with X) are one blow, the biggest (signature over heavy over light), and the smaller is let go of and told with the refusal code chord (docs/controls/chord-pick.md). Before, the director took the light, then the heavy, then the signature, so a B pressed with an X was dropped with no word. Off.

flightStrikeB.description: With signatureRtOnly: LT + B is left as the B press for the flight strike to read (data/director/interrupts.json zip.flightStrikes.enabled; its biggest blow) instead of being sent as Y's heavy. LB + B and RB + B are unchanged. Set together with the flight strikes' switch and dodgeHeld. Off.

dodgeHeld.description: LT held, in the intent's second word, bit 26 (docs/controls/dodge-held.md; needs rightStick): the intent says whether the dodge control is physically down this tick, so the flight strike's take-back (a face press within 4 ticks of LT, LT still held) can be read. Off.

hapticStages.description: The charge rumble from the director's stages (docs/controls/stage-pulses.md; needs hapticLadder and rightStick): a pulse at every stage of Encounter's stick_stage cue (a base fighter's two stages are two pulses, the last the thud), and the hub's own three rungs step aside. Flip with beam-move and strike-stages: with them off no cue comes and a hold is silent. Off.

hapticImpact.description: Orb's 2026-10-05 rumble picks that were missing (docs/controls/impact-haptics.md): a landed blow felt by the one who landed it (blow_land) and by the one it hit (hit_taken), a close (close_surge), a launch felt by the one sent (launch_felt), a landing (landing_thud) and a building breaking (building_break, both pads). Independent of rightStick. Off.

stallKeep.description: No input lost in a stall (docs/controls/stall-keep.md; needs rightStick): the layout keeps the strike stick's furthest point (and a strike key's press) since its last build and reads it once, so a flick that came and went between two steps (the page hitched and several steps read one snapshot) is still a flick. Off.

hapticIncomingBeam.description: The beam-answer window rumbles on the receiver's pad: a crescendo of incoming_beam pulses from Encounter's beam_window cue to the front's arrival (docs/design/rule-of-cool-map.md row 40). Independent of rightStick. Off.

quickRead.description: The quick read (docs/controls/responsiveness.md; needs rightStick): the strike and the brace settle strike.settleQuick ticks after the crossing, the vanish resolves on the second press + leftHand.vanishSettle, and the layout publishes the stick's pre-read for the pose (render only). Off.

rightStick.description: The right-hand attacks (docs/controls/right-hand-attacks.md): the strike stick, the left hand's brace and vanish, hybrids 3 and 10 (stances.json withRightStick), R3 freed (off).

strike.description: The strike stick (switches.rightStick; docs/controls/right-hand-attacks.md section 1, sim/input/strike_read.gd and strike_law.gd). Optional: the code defaults are these values.

quant.description: The deflection is quantised to 1 / quant (16).

on.description: A push past this rescaled deflection is a request (0.60).

off.description: A stick back under this is at rest (0.35); under `on`.

settle.description: Ticks from the crossing to the request's start; the direction is taken then (2).

bufferTicks.description: The stick's input buffer (docs/controls/responsiveness.md section 8): a request that finds the fighter unable to act (the host's set_can_act) waits this many ticks for him, the newest flick only, and is dropped and told if he cannot in time. 0 is off (the default); 9 is the smallest useful version.

refuseTicks.description: Live ticks a stick request may wait for the director to start its strike before the pad is told it was refused (30).

refuseTicksKept.description: With switches.flickKept: the live ticks a stick request may wait before the pad is told it was unanswered (120: above the director's 90-tick keep, pendFollow.maxTicks, and the longest answer the probe saw, 113). Without the switch, refuseTicks.

aimTrail.description: While switches.beamAim is on, the degrees the shown aim trails the stick before it moves (4): the thumb's wobble inside the band does not walk the sector.

aimLatchTicks.description: While switches.beamAim is on, the throw's aim is the mean of this many of the last rim ticks (3).

aimLatchPeak.description: While switches.beamAim is on, a tick counts as the rim when its deflection is at least this fraction of the hold's peak (0.85).

settleQuick.description: The settle while switches.quickRead is on (1). 0 and 1 start on the same tick: the request starts at the build after the crossing at the soonest.

preAt.description: The quick read's pre-read of the strike stick begins at this rescaled deflection (0.25), while the stick leans in, before strike.on. For the pose only: never in the intent.

dwell.description: D: a stick back at rest before this many live ticks is the quick strike; still out, it is a charge (12).

levels.description: Live ticks since the start at which a martial strike reaches level 1, 2 and 3 (12, 30, 50).

beamLevels.description: The same for a beam or the signature: the beam's own stages, 12, 28, 46, 66, 90 and 120 live ticks (Encounter's charge stages, so the pad's pulses meet them; three to six rungs). The intent's rsLevel stays 0 to 3 whatever the count; the director reads the full count through level_at.

lockout.description: L: a face press after a stick command waits this many ticks (6).

reverseLockout.description: R: a strike request after a face press waits this many ticks (8).

swapLockout.description: L for the left-handed swap, measured on the other thumb (6).

queueDepth.description: Face presses kept while the stick is out (3).

queueTicks.description: A queued face press older than this is gone (36).

style.description: The default strike style; the player's own setting wins (hold).

mirror.description: The D-pad mirror default: auto is on only for a pad the host says has no right stick (auto).

freeR3.description: R3 (and L3) bind no Escape while the switch is on (true).

inertMasks.description: Stance masks on which the strike stick does nothing, and holds nothing: pure 4a leaves the power layer (4) and the lay (3) inert ([3, 4]).

leftHand.description: The left hand's reads (switches.rightStick; sim/input/left_hand.gd): LB and a left flick is a brace, LB and LT together are the vanish. Optional: the code defaults are these values.

braceStyle.description: The brace's assist default: flick reads a flick from rest with LB down (and a keyboard tap); press leaves only the brace button (flick).

braceRest.description: Ticks the left stick sat at rest before a flick can set a read (10).

braceRise.description: Ticks from leaving rest to the push past `on` for a flick; slower is a lean (3).

braceTap.description: A keyboard tap of a direction key down and up inside this is a brace with LB down (8).

restLevel.description: Raw deflection under which the left stick is at rest (0.2).

vanishWindow.description: LB and LT pressed within this many ticks (either order) are the vanish chord (6, = tapHold.chordWindow).

vanishSettle.description: Ticks after the later press at which the chord's direction is taken at the earliest (2).

read.description: The press reader (docs/controls/agency-input.md 1a, sim/input/press_read.gd): how holds, mashes and taps in time with the blows are told apart, and the contact debounce. Optional: the code defaults are these values.

logSize.description: Attack presses the press log keeps: the fight alchemist's read (5).

holdTicks.description: A button down this long is a hold; defaults to tapHold.holdStart.

beatHalf.description: A press within this many ticks of a blow's contact is on the beat (4: an 8-tick window).

rhythmOf.description: Rhythm looks at the last N presses ...

rhythmNeed.description: ... and needs this many of them on the beat.

mashPresses.description: A mash is this many presses ...

mashGap.description: ... with every gap this many ticks or fewer.

mashClear.description: A mash is over after this many ticks without a press.

staleTicks.description: A log older than this reads as nothing.

mixShort.description: The alchemist's short mix window, in presses.

assistFactor.description: Accessibility: the beat window is multiplied by this.

perfectStreak.description: This many perfect presses in a row make a timed string.

expireTicks.description: The whole window of presses lapses after this many ticks with no press (90; agency-pass.md section 20), not press by press.

powerShare.description: Heavies over this percent of the presses present make the power style; up to it, combo; none, blur (60).

steadyPresses.description: A steady mash is this many presses in a row, evenly spaced and each on a blow's contact (4; section 20).

blurBeatHalf.description: Each of those presses within this many ticks of a blow's contact (2; the combo's timed press is beatHalf, 4).

blurBeatBonus.description: Added to blurBeatHalf on touch or at 30 fps; the assist factor doubles the result (2).

debounce.description: A press of an attack button within this many ticks of its own release is the same press.

zipMashPresses.description: A zip's speed reading: the starter and this many minus one more presses (3) ...

zipMashGap.description: ... each within this many ticks of the one before (10).

burstStart.description: A light (X) held this many LIVE ticks starts the burst; the classifier's hold for X (8; Game Design is ruling between 4, 8 and more). Replaces holdLight.

windupMedium.description: Y, the medium: a tap lands when this wind-up ends (12 live ticks); still down at wind-up plus grace it is the charged medium.

windupHeavy.description: B, the heavy, in the martial stance: its wind-up (28).

windupContext.description: A: the shove's wind-up (12); held to wind-up plus grace it is the tackle's coil.

windupGrace.description: A release in this many ticks after the wind-up's end is still a tap, on every device (4).

pairWindow.description: Two adjacent face buttons within this many ticks are one pair (3; doubled by the assist setting).

pairFresh.description: ... and neither button was pressed in this many ticks before (8).

flurryGapX.description: The pace of the X flurry: a press of the same button within this many ticks continues it (12).

flurryGapY.description: The pace of the Y flurry (16).

flurryGapB.description: The pace of the B flurry (34).

flurryNeedSlow.description: Presses that make a Y or B flurry (2); X uses mashPresses.

mixupSwitches.description: Changes of button in one chain of X, Y and B presses that make a mix-up (2).

simpleMediumStart.description: The Simple layout's attack: held this many live ticks, the release is the medium (12).

catchTell.description: The grapple's catch: the tell from the press of A in reach (10); the carry and the brace decide at the tell plus windupGrace (14).

simpleHeavyStart.description: ... and held this many, the release is the heavy (28).

awayDead.description: The dead zone for pushing away (I2c).

fullAt.description: A stick reaches full speed at this fraction of its travel (0.9 by default in code).
